# Contextual producer and completion

A public static method retains three closed context inputs and a Boolean
before a covariant producer and contravariant completion of its sole method
formal. Frozen callers check all original metadata, four invocation routes,
ordered context effects, partial state, exact failures, nulls, opaque sentinel
results, wide boxed values and callbacks supplied outside the input DEX.
Source and dependency modes compare 64 fresh JVM cases twice, reject
Signature-only controls with unchanged Code, and detect independent wrong
programs. No application input or recovered application code is executed.
